findings.detail: Complete isolated warm-flow models reach owner-start with a final capacity observation stale by1h or a different published deployment identity, after an earlier valid canonical READY. Existing strict auxiliary/resource validation does not inspect those fields, whereas frozen source readiness.py rejects them at lines272/342. Add a source-aligned fast current completion guard for fresh end/start, preserving one full early CLI and all original bounds; do not relabel the cached result as T0 freshness.
